text:
Priya: quick heads-up — StellarCloud asked to open eu-west-3 for our Dedicated SKU for next-quarter launch. Can we confirm capacity and KMS flow?
Miguel: checking infra quotas now. last I saw we had headroom for 12 p4d-equivalent nodes, need to confirm noisy-neighbor plan.
Sasha (StellarCloud): @Priya thanks — partner wants a guaranteed 4x reserved nodes with burst to 12 during launch week. They also need KMS integration tested (customer-managed key).
Priya: perfect. main asks: 1) reserve 4 nodes 2) burst policy up to 12 3) KMS entitlements & test key 4) marketplace listing timing 5) joint announcement date window.
Miguel: for 1/2 we need ticket to infra to carve the nodepool and a CIDR for staging. I can open that now.
Miguel: opening infra ticket — link: https://redwood-infra/ops/INC-8342
jenkins-bot: deploy pipeline queued for nodepool-provisioner (pr #482).
Sasha (StellarCloud): on KMS — partner requires a bring-your-own-key flow plus a fallback to our KM service. They sent a short spec, attaching gist: https://gist.github.com/stellarcloud/kms-flow-2026
Priya: @Sasha can you confirm the spec includes wrap/unwrap and key-rotation timing? Legal will require explicit rotation SLA.
Sasha (StellarCloud): yes — 90-day rotation, and logs to their SIEM.
Daniel: FYI legal needs the standard marketplace T&Cs plus a data-processing appendix for EU-only workload handling. I can draft. Timeline?
Priya: aiming for soft-launch week of May 12. Need legal signoff by Apr 20 to hit that.
Mark (Partner Ops): onboarding checklist from partner side: contract signed, KMS cert, marketplace listing assets, and joint press draft. We're missing the press draft.
Priya: I'll take press draft with marketing. Can we lock the announcement cadence to a staged rollout? partner wants regional GA then global.
Miguel: recommended rollout: canary to 2 internal accounts 4/30, partner beta 5/6, GA 5/12. That respects capacity and gives time for perf tuning.
Sasha (StellarCloud): beta window works. partner SIs will run integration tests 5/6–5/10. They need a test KMS key and a sandbox nodepool.
Miguel: sandbox nodepool CIDR: 10.40.32.0/24 — will allocate after INC-8342 approved.
Daniel: I'll share a short DP appendix draft by Apr 11. @Priya please review and tag marketing/legal.
Priya: thanks. action items: Miguel open infra ticket (done), Daniel draft DP appendix, Sasha provide final KMS cert and SI test plan, Mark confirm contract signed + marketplace asset checklist, Priya + marketing draft joint press by Apr 18.
Mark (Partner Ops): contract is signed, I uploaded the signed MSA to the partner drive. link: https://drive.redwood/partners/stellarcloud/msa-signed.pdf
Sasha (StellarCloud): uploaded their SI test matrix to gist (link in DM). I'll ping Raj from their SI to the thread once they accept invite.
Priya: small compliance note — for eu-west-3 we need to ensure audit-logs retention 7 years per partner request. ops, can we set retention policy?
Miguel: retention policy can be set per nodepool; default is 1 year. ops will need to enable 7y retention flag. Adding to INC-8342.
jenkins-bot: infra ticket INC-8342 updated: nodepool provisioning + KMS entitlement + retention flag.
Daniel: once DP appendix is in, I'll loop legal for signature on marketplace listing.
Priya: final check — who owns the announcement draft? me + marketing. Who will do the joint webinar? Mark + Sasha?
Mark (Partner Ops): yes, partner ops + StellarCloud will co-run webinar. I'll coordinate dates after press draft.
Sasha (StellarCloud): Raj from SI joined the thread: Raj: ping — we'll start integration test planning tomorrow.
Priya: great — I'll close this thread once all items are green. for visibility, tagging: @Miguel @Daniel @Mark @Sasha. :white_check_mark:
